arguments.sql:
SELECT p.Admission, COUNT(*) AS examination_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients,
       COUNT(julianday(p."First Date")) AS parseable_visits,
       COUNT(julianday(e."Examination Date")) AS parseable_exams,
       MIN(p."First Date") AS earliest_visit, MIN(e."Examination Date") AS earliest_exam
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.Admission

WITH first_examination AS (
    SELECT e.ID, MIN(julianday(e."Examination Date")) AS first_exam_day
    FROM Examination AS e
    GROUP BY e.ID
)
SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(f.first_exam_day - julianday(p."First Date"))) AS INTEGER) AS average_delay_days
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN first_examination AS f ON f.ID = p.ID
WHERE instr(p.Admission, '+') > 0
LIMIT 1
